### What does the Ed-Fi Data Standard cover?
The Ed-Fi Data Standard focuses on K–12 information related to students and their academic performance.

Many Ed-Fi Technology Suite aggregate or otherwise process information to give a look at school, district, and state-level trends – but central to our philosophy is that any aggregation should be calculated based on student-level information, since each student's story is unique.
